verdict.rationale: Fathom documents its own API for getting your data out. A download endpoint generates a downloadable recording file delivered via a signed URL, and transcript and summary endpoints return that data directly. Admins can read all shared meetings across teams. There is no documented one-click or bulk full-account export, the file formats are not stated as open, and nothing covers account deletion or offboarding. Missing for 10: documented bulk/full-account export, explicit open-format guarantees (e.g. MP4/JSON/TXT), coverage of all data types (comments, clips, playlists, scorecards), account-deletion/leave process, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Starts async generation of a downloadable file and returns a `download_id` to poll.
When the download is completed, the payload carries a short-lived signed URL for the generated file.
If you do not send `destination_url`, the endpoint will return the data directly.
grant one or more Admins view access to all shared calls; that Admin’s key can then read everything shared across teams.
